retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle, dramatic urban portrait featuring a central figure against a stormy sky with lightning and heavy 3D chrome typography.
triggerTerms: low angle man in leather jacket city background

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in dark clothing stands atop a stone ledge, towering over a dark cityscape. The background is a turbulent, olive-toned sky filled with electric lightning bolts. A massive, metallic 3D title spans the mid-ground, featuring sharp, beveled edges and a chrome finish.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure vertically bisects the composition
Large-scale typography sits behind the figure's legs but in front of the city
Lightning bolts frame the head and shoulders of the subject
Low-angle perspective creates a sense of dominance and scale
coreInvariants: High-contrast lightning against a dark, desaturated sky
Heavy 3D metallic texture on display typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length central figure, scaled to appear as a giant relative to the city below.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's torso and the large chrome lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright lightning at the top, down the figure to the large text, then out to the city horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and filled; minimal negative space due to clouds and city detail.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark olive and charcoal grey sky and city.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale yellow for lightning and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast in the lightning strikes.

letterConstructionRules: High-gloss chrome texture with environmental reflections
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' features elongated, pointed outer strokes
The 'D' has a circular cutout detail on the top right

composition.overlap: behind subject, in front of background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant custom display face paired with standard sans-serif metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar flared serif structure for the base skeleton.
Provides the wide, sturdy stance and small serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle shot of a man in a black leather jacket standing on a stone ledge overlooking a dark, gritty cityscape at night. The sky is dark olive-green with dramatic white lightning bolts striking behind him.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, 3D chrome-textured uppercase lettering across the middle, using a sharp-serifed bold font with heavy beveling and metallic reflections.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a 3D metallic chrome finish?
Are there visible lightning bolts in the sky?
Is the color palette dominated by dark olive and black?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any existing brand logos or specific artist names
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text appears to exist in 3D space
Check that lightning does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained
Confirm the color palette remains moody and desaturated
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle urban portrait + stormy lightning sky + 3D chrome display type.
